capabilities: display a Solar Hijri calendar with Iranian holidays and events
create and open daily, weekly, monthly, seasonal and yearly notes
customize note paths and names with Jalali and Gregorian placeholders
insert date and event placeholders into note templates
link dates and date phrases to calendar notes via @ references
disambiguation: More than a calendar display; it also creates and links dated periodic notes with dynamic paths and template placeholders.
extras: Bilingual Persian/English interface; Lunar Hijri dates can follow Iran's Crescent Committee or Saudi Arabia's Umm al-Qura; documentation is partly in Persian; includes its own bundled font.
intentEvidence: adds the Solar Hijri calendar alongside the Gregorian and Lunar Hijri calendars to Obsidian
problem: Obsidian's calendar and daily-notes tooling is Gregorian-only, so users who journal by the Iranian solar calendar cannot create or navigate dated notes in their own calendar.
summary: Calendar sidebar and periodic-notes manager built on the Solar Hijri (Jalali) calendar, with Gregorian and Lunar Hijri support.
